lines.text: Josiah commanded the people to keep the Passover, and no such Passover had been observed since the days of the judges.
Josiah removed the mediums, spiritists, household gods and idols to carry out the words of the law Hilkiah found.
There was no king like Josiah, who turned to the LORD according to all the Law of Solomon.
The LORD did not turn from His burning anger against Judah because of all that Amon had done, and He would remove Judah from His sight.
Pharaoh Neco killed Josiah at Megiddo, and his servants brought his body to Jerusalem and buried him in his own tomb.
